reasons.plausibility: The systematic Co-for-Ni substitution to tune both mechanical and magnetocaloric properties in such Mn–Ni–Si–Fe–Co–Ge alloys is scientifically well-justified and aligns with known effects of composition on phase stability and magnetic transitions.
reasons.testability: They specify clear experimental characterizations (XRD, DSC, magnetization, direct ΔTad) that would provide definitive data to confirm or refute the proposed structural and magnetic changes.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a specific compositional tuning pathway and outlines measurable benchmarks to balance mechanical integrity and caloric response, making it relevant to practical research on these high-entropy refrigerants.
